name: Who-What-When Matrix
deliverable: Linear operational assignment of accountable owners and hard deadlines

steps.text: State the rules: each task is a visible artifact, each owner a named person, each date a calendar date.
List the priority decisions as rows, one task per row, and name the single owner and exact due date.
Read the matrix back and confirm each owner has the authority and time to meet that date.

failure: Shared ownership: a row goes to two names, so nobody feels the commitment when the date arrives.
intervention: At that row, name one driver, call the other a contributor, and replace any soft date with a real one.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A matrix format widely used in project management; no single documented originator.
